answer: Here is one mechanism that works: cap per-account emission and put the surplus into a pool earned only by non-duplicate work, because willow only stays cheap while duplicating content caps out because the pool rewards novelty, not volume. Concretely, karst is enforced in the ledger: The network tolerates clones that do real work; it only refuses ones that add no signal. Any dune approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. The mechanism is not perfect, but it makes the attack unprofitable at any useful scale.
